tools.name: tripo_plan
tools.title: Plan workflow (confirm before running)
tools.description: Draft an advisory workflow, not an authorization ticket or execution gate. Free, no upstream call. For 3D generation steps supply structured generation parameters to resolve the final model using the same rules as dry_run; v3.1/P2 generation steps then carry the official list price of that step as cost_estimate, while P1, legacy models and all other steps are not_estimated (never zero credits). Legacy free-text params are not parsed or validated; model stays unresolved. Review an exact dry_run payload, and current pricing for not_estimated steps, before confirming any billed call. Skip for pure read-only queries.

goal.description: what the user wants, in one sentence

purpose.description: what this step does for the user

model.description: v3.1-20260211 (v3.1, H3.1) = official default flagship (H series), also required for dense geometry and v3-only options; P2-20260801 (P2, P2.0) = P-series topology for real-time, game, editable, low-poly or quad assets (48–50000 tri / 48–25000 quad); P1-20260311 (P1, P1.0) = explicit lower-cost P-series choice (50–20000 faces); v3.0-20250812 / v2.5-20250123 (H3.0 / H2.5) = legacy, only to reproduce old projects. Full version IDs and short names are accepted. When omitted, dense geometry, v3-only options and face budgets outside P2's range choose v3.1; game/realtime/editable/low-poly/quad requests and P2-range face budgets choose P2; everything else uses v3.1. Visual and texture quality, and platform names such as PC or console, do not choose a geometry model by themselves. P2 lists at 100–130 credits per generation versus 10–50 for v3.1 before add-ons; dry_run and tripo_plan report the list price (P1 and legacy models are not estimated). Image and multiview tools have no prompt intent, so explicitly set P2 when their known conversational use is game/realtime/editable.

texture.description: generate textures (default true); false = bare geometry, and pbr is then sent as false unless set

pbr.description: PBR materials (implies texture); default false — set true only when the user explicitly asks for PBR

texture_quality.description: fast = quickest, same size and credits as standard, needs texture model v3.5 (picked automatically when texture_version is omitted); extreme = 8K, extra credits

texture_version.description: texture model, independent of the geometry model: v3.5 = newest (needed for fast/delight); default follows the geometry (v2.5 → v2.5, otherwise v3.0); short names and full IDs (v3.5-20260815 …) are accepted

delight.description: remove baked-in lighting from the reference before texturing (default true; texture model v3.5 only)

geometry_quality.description: detailed = Ultra mode with finer geometry and up to 2M faces (v3.x only; extra credits)

face_limit.description: max face count; when model is omitted, a budget inside P2's range (48–50000, or 48–25000 with quad) chooses P2 and one outside it chooses v3.1

quad.description: quad topology (P2 or v3.x; output is FBX); automatically chooses P2 unless a v3-only requirement applies

generate_parts.description: segmented editable parts, bare geometry (v3.x only)

auto_size.description: scale to real-world size in meters (AR/VR, game engines)

compress.description: meshopt geometry compression for a smaller file

export_uv.description: UV unwrapping during generation (default true); false = faster and smaller, UVs are created when texturing

model_seed.description: fixed seed → identical geometry on re-runs

texture_seed.description: fixed seed → identical textures; keep model_seed and vary this to re-texture the same shape

export_orientation.description: forward axis of this export only; leave unset when the model will be post-processed (texture/rig/convert) and orient in tripo_convert at the end instead

dry_run.description: true = validate only, no task and no credits: returns the resolved model, the exact request payload after linkage rules and the adjustment notes; call again without dry_run to submit

generation.description: 3D generation model options only; text-to-3D also requires its exact prompt. Not an executable request; use dry_run for the full payload including image references.

params.description: key parameters in plain text, e.g. model=P2 quad=true face_limit=5000

tools.name: tripo_upload_image
tools.title: Re-host image from URL
tools.description: Fetch an image URL server-side and re-host it on Tripo, returning a file_token usable as input anywhere. Use when a URL might not be fetchable by Tripo itself (signed/short-lived links, region-locked or slow hosts) or to fail fast before spending credits; plain public URLs can be passed to generation tools directly.

url.description: http(s) URL of a PNG/JPEG/WebP image, ≤20MB

tools.name: tripo_import_model
tools.title: Import model file
tools.description: Import an existing 3D model (GLB/GLTF/FBX/OBJ/STL, ≤150MB) into Tripo as a task, so it gets a preview and a task_id reusable across texture/convert/rig/segment steps without re-uploading. input is a public model file URL, a file_token, or an absolute local model file path (uploaded first).

input.description: model file_token or public model file URL; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

orientation.description: align_image rotates the model to the input viewpoint (needs texture)

tools.title: Multiview to 3D
tools.description: Create a 3D model from 2–4 orthographic views of the same object (front required; add left/back/right for accuracy), or from the 4-view sheet of a finished tripo_image_to_multiview / tripo_edit_multiview task via multiview_task_id. Each view accepts an image URL / file_token. Returns task_id; then call tripo_task_wait.

front.description: front view (required unless multiview_task_id is set); an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

left.description: image URL / file_token; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

back.description: image URL / file_token; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

right.description: image URL / file_token; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

multiview_task_id.description: a successful tripo_image_to_multiview / tripo_edit_multiview task whose 4 views to use instead of front/left/back/right

orientation.description: align_image rotates the model to the input viewpoint (needs texture)

texture_alignment.description: prioritize input colors (default) or generated geometry

tools.name: tripo_image_to_splat
tools.title: Image to Gaussian splat
tools.description: Create a 3D Gaussian splat (.splat) from a single image — a radiance-field scene capture, not an editable mesh (texture/rig/convert do not apply). input accepts an image URL / file_token / task_id.

input.description: image URL / file_token / task_id; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

model_seed.description: fixed seed → identical splat on re-runs

tools.name: tripo_generate_image
tools.title: Generate / edit image
tools.description: Tripo image generation for 3D prep: text→image when no input is given, image editing/fusion (image(s)+prompt→image) when input or inputs is set. Templates automate common prep: t_pose (character to T-pose), asset_extraction (text mode), 3d_enhance (image mode), character_completion, variants, figure. Negative prompts go inside prompt after `--no`. The resulting task_id can feed tripo_image_to_3d directly.

input.description: source image URL / file_token / task_id — set to edit an image, omit for text-to-image; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

inputs.description: several reference images for editing/fusion, referred to as image[1], image[2], … in the prompt; max 4 (seedream) / 10 (banana) / 16 (chat_image); an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

model.description: default seedream_v4 (text) / seedream_v5 (image edit; seedream_v4 not accepted there); chat_image_2.5_flare = faster tier, chat_image_2.5_sunburst = refined tier that best preserves untouched areas when editing; chat_image_1 is retired (rejected locally since 2026-10-23) and chat_image_1.5 on 2026-12-01; gemini-2.5-flash / gemini-3-pro / gemini-3.1-flash are sent as banana / banana_pro / banana2

size.description: output size, default 2048x2048; accepted values differ per model: banana fixed 1024x1024/832x1248/1248x832/864x1184/1184x864/896x1152/1152x896/768x1344/1344x768/1536x672; banana_pro 1K/2K/4K or WxH; banana2 0.5K/1K/2K/4K; seedream_v4 2K/4K, seedream_v5 2K/3K (WxH within 1:16–16:1); chat_image_1.5 1024x1024/1024x1536/1536x1024/auto; chat_image_2/2.5 auto or WxH with each side ≤3840 and a multiple of 16, long side ≤3× short side, 655360–8294400 total pixels

aspect_ratio.description: banana models only (1:1, 3:2, 16:9, …); other models take the shape from size or the prompt

watermark.description: seedream models only: visible AI-content watermark (default false)

quality.description: chat_image_2 (low/medium/high) and chat_image_2.5 models (also xhigh/max) only; default low; high/xhigh/max cost extra credits

background.description: chat_image_2.5 models only; transparent needs output_format png

tools.name: tripo_image_to_multiview
tools.title: Image to multiview sheet
tools.description: Generate a consistent 4-view sheet (front/left/back/right) from a single image. The resulting task_id can feed tripo_multiview_to_3d (multiview_task_id) or be revised via tripo_edit_multiview.

input.description: image URL / file_token / task_id; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

tools.name: tripo_edit_multiview
tools.title: Edit multiview sheet
tools.description: Edit individual views of a tripo_image_to_multiview result before modeling: one instruction per view to change (1–4). input is that task_id (a multiview sheet URL / file_token also works).

input.description: a successful tripo_image_to_multiview task_id; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

tools.name: tripo_task_status
tools.title: Task status
tools.description: Get the current status and fresh download URLs of a Tripo task. URLs in results expire in ~5 minutes — call this again whenever a link is needed. steps=true also returns the raw task detail with its per-stage breakdown.

tools.name: tripo_task_wait
tools.title: Wait for task
tools.description: Poll a Tripo task until it finishes or timeout_seconds elapses (returns latest state either way; generation typically takes 1–4 minutes — call again while status is queued/running). status=success means done; failed/banned include failure_reason.

timeout_seconds.description: default 50; capped at 55 because MCP clients commonly time tool calls out at 60s

tools.name: tripo_task_list
tools.title: Batch task status
tools.description: Get the status and fresh download URLs of up to 100 Tripo tasks in one call (e.g. a batch of generations). Unknown or expired ids are listed under missed.

tools.name: tripo_texture
tools.title: Texture / retexture
tools.description: Generate or regenerate textures for a model. input accepts a model-producing task_id, a file_token, or a model file URL (glb). Guidance is optional for Tripo-generated models: prompt (+style_image), or image, or images — exactly one. Billed separately.

input.description: model task_id / file_token / model file URL; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

texture_quality.description: fast = quickest, same credits as standard, needs model v3.5 (picked automatically when model is omitted)

pbr.description: PBR materials; default false — set true only when the user explicitly asks for PBR

model.description: texture model version (default v3.0; v3.5 = newest, needed for fast/delight); short names and full IDs (v3.5-20260815 …) are accepted

prompt.description: text describing the desired texture style

style_image.description: style reference image URL / file_token; only together with prompt; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

image.description: single reference image URL / file_token (re-supply the original reference when retexturing a task); an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

images.description: exactly 4 reference images in order [front, left, back, right]; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

part_names.description: texture only these parts of a segmented model

bake.description: bake advanced material effects into base textures (default true)

delight.description: remove baked-in lighting from the reference before texturing (default true; model v3.5 only)

tools.name: tripo_rig_check
tools.title: Rig precheck
tools.description: Check whether a model can be rigged before spending credits on tripo_rig. input accepts a model-producing task_id, a file_token, or a model file URL; the finished task output states riggability.

input.description: model task_id / file_token / model file URL; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

tools.name: tripo_rig
tools.title: Rig model
tools.description: Add an animation skeleton to a model (seven named body types, or others). input accepts a model-producing task_id, a file_token, or a model file URL. Required before tripo_animate. Billed separately. Unless model is set, every body type uses the v3.0 rig (on non-biped body types it matches the v2.5 creature rig at the same price). Set model=v1.0 up front when the user wants humanoid clips beyond the universal presets (dance, greetings, sports… — the 90+ preset:biped:* clips exist only on v1.0 rigs); the result reports the model used and which preset family tripo_animate must use.

input.description: model task_id / file_token / model file URL; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

rig_type.description: body type; take it from tripo_rig_check (default biped); others = none of the named topologies (v3.0 only)

spec.description: bone naming, biped only: tripo (default) or mixamo; v3.0 also offers actorcore, unity (Unity Humanoid), unreal (UE Mannequin) and vrm (VRM 1.0)

model.description: v3.0-20260909 (v3.0) = recommended humanoid rig, faster and better at the same price, matching v2.5 on other body types; the only model for rig_type=others and the actorcore/unity/unreal/vrm specs. v2.5-20260210 (v2.5) = creature rig for quadruped/hexapod/octopod/avian/serpentine/aquatic. v3.0 and v2.5 share one preset set (generic clips for bipeds, body-type clips for creatures). v1.0-20240301 (v1.0) = legacy humanoid rig and server default, the only one with the 90+ preset:biped:* clips. Defaults to v3.0 for every body type when omitted. The CLI names rig-v3.0 / rig-v2.5 / rig-v1.0 are accepted too (rig-v2.0 = v2.5)

tools.name: tripo_animate
tools.title: Animate rigged model
tools.description: Apply preset animations to a rig task (input must be a successful tripo_rig task_id). Preset names depend on the rig model and body type reported by tripo_rig: v3.0/v2.5 biped rigs (v3.0 is the default rig) take preset:idle, preset:walk, preset:run, preset:dive, preset:climb, preset:jump, preset:slash, preset:shoot, preset:hurt, preset:fall, preset:turn; v3.0/v2.5 creature rigs take only their body-type preset (preset:quadruped:walk, preset:hexapod:walk, preset:octopod:walk, preset:serpentine:march, preset:aquatic:march; avian and others have none); v1.0 humanoid rigs take only the 90+ preset:biped:* clips (preset:biped:idle, preset:biped:walk, preset:biped:run, preset:biped:jump, preset:biped:dance_01, preset:biped:wave_goodbye_01, …). Billed per animation, max 5.

bake_animation.description: Deprecated and ignored; omit this parameter.

animations.description: e.g. ["preset:walk", "preset:idle"] for a v3.0/v2.5 biped rig, ["preset:quadruped:walk"] for a quadruped rig, ["preset:biped:walk", "preset:biped:dance_01"] for a v1.0 humanoid rig

animate_in_place.description: true when game code drives movement

export_with_geometry.description: include the mesh in the export (default true)

tools.name: tripo_convert
tools.title: Convert / export format
tools.description: Convert a model to a target format (GLTF/USDZ/FBX/OBJ/STL/3MF), optionally retopologizing via face_limit/quad. input accepts a model-producing task_id, a file_token, or a model file URL. Note: quad output is always FBX (GLTF is rejected, other formats are overridden); 3MF output is single colour, so for colour prints export OBJ with export_vertex_colors; non-default options bill as "complex convert".

input.description: model task_id / file_token / model file URL; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

fbx_preset.description: FBX only; blender (default) / 3dsmax / mixamo / bake_scale (bake the scale transform into the geometry)

tools.name: tripo_decimate
tools.title: Decimate to low-poly
tools.description: Reduce a high-poly model to a low-poly target. input accepts a model-producing task_id, a file_token, or a model file URL. Default model v2.0: face_limit 500–20000 tri / 500–10000 quad, bakes original textures onto the result; v3.0: newest retopology with the same face_limit windows, bake and part_names, billed above v2.0 (quad output above triangle), and the only model that accepts smart_uv (UV unwrap in the same task); legacy v1.0: face_limit required, up to 2,000,000 tri / 150,000 quad, no bake/part_names.

input.description: model task_id / file_token / model file URL; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

bake.description: bake textures onto the low-poly (not v1.0)

part_names.description: decimate only these named parts (not v1.0)

smart_uv.description: unwrap UVs during retopology at no extra cost (model v3.0 only); no UV layout preview — use tripo_smart_uv for that

tools.name: tripo_smart_uv
tools.title: Smart UV unwrap
tools.description: Re-unwrap a model's UVs and remap its existing textures, rigging and animation onto the new layout. input accepts a model-producing task_id, a file_token, or a model file URL; it must not exceed 80,000 equivalent triangles (a quad counts as two) — larger inputs fail after creation and the credits are refunded, so reduce them with tripo_decimate first. Besides model_url, output_urls carries uv_render_url (UV layout preview image); give it to the user only when they ask to see the UV layout. For retopology plus UVs in one task use tripo_decimate with model=v3.0 and smart_uv=true instead (no layout preview). Billed separately.

input.description: model task_id / file_token / model file URL; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

bake.description: bake the existing textures onto the new UV layout (default true); false returns geometry with UVs only

compress.description: meshopt geometry compression for a smaller file

tools.name: tripo_segment
tools.title: Segment mesh into parts
tools.description: Split a model into named parts (e.g. for per-part editing or conversion). input accepts a model-producing task_id, a file_token, or a model file URL. v1.0 (default) is geometry-based; v2.0 (Beta) adds semantic labels with granularity/connectivity controls or a reference mask. Follow up with tripo_mesh_complete to close the cut surfaces.

input.description: model task_id / file_token / model file URL; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

split_by_connectivity.description: v2.0 only: also split by connected components (default true)

ref_image.description: v2.0 only: reference image / segmentation mask (URL or file_token); overrides granularity and connectivity; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

tools.name: tripo_mesh_complete
tools.title: Complete segmented mesh
tools.description: Close/complete the cut surfaces of a segmentation result (input must be a successful tripo_segment task_id).

tools.name: tripo_mesh_edit
tools.title: Edit mesh region (P2)
tools.description: Regenerate or refine one region of an existing model with the P2 pipeline (model is fixed to P2-20260801). input accepts a model-producing task_id, a file_token, or a model file URL; bbox is the axis-aligned box in model space that bounds the region to redo. Optional ref_image guides the result semantically. Billed separately; the rest of the mesh is kept.

input.description: model task_id / file_token / model file URL; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

bbox.description: [[x1,y1,z1],[x2,y2,z2]] axis-aligned bounding box in model space, e.g. [[-0.5,-0.5,-0.5],[0.5,0.5,0.5]]

face_limit.description: max face count of the result (≥100; adaptive when omitted)

ref_image.description: reference image URL or file_token for semantic guidance; an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

compress.description: meshopt geometry compression for a smaller file

tools.name: tripo_smart_segment
tools.title: Smart segment (prompted)
tools.description: Segment a model or image into semantic parts, optionally guided by a hint. input is a file_token or URL only (task ids are not resolved here); the model pipeline accepts GLB only.

input.description: file_token or URL (GLB model or image; NOT a task_id); an absolute local file path also works (uploaded first)

transform.description: seg_type=model only: 4×4 column-major transform for the model (default identity)

tools.name: tripo_balance
tools.title: Account balance
tools.description: Credit balance of the connected Tripo account, with a link to the informational plans page.

tools.name: tripo_usage
tools.title: Credit usage
tools.description: Per-task credit consumption of the connected Tripo account (task_id, type, credits_consumed, created_at) with total_credits over the returned entries. Pass task_ids to get the actual charges of one workflow (e.g. every task created after a tripo_plan) and report the total plus the per-task breakdown; ids absent from the ledger are listed under missed (failed/cancelled tasks are not charged).

limit.description: return at most this many entries (default 50)

task_ids.description: only these tasks, e.g. all task_ids of the workflow just finished

tools.name: tripo_download
tools.title: Download task files
tools.description: Save the files of a successful task (model, preview.png, task.json and any other outputs) into a local folder and return their absolute paths. Fetches fresh download URLs itself, so it works any time after the task succeeds. Free; writes only to this machine.

output_dir.description: folder to save into (default: tripo-out/<task type>-<task id prefix> under the server working directory)
